reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A typed chat start (chat.accept/v1, chat.resume/v1) interrupted before it saved its turn (no runtime_chat_bindings row, no response frame) is queued again for the next owner, bounded to three runs, on the dead-owner reconcile, fenced-claim and worker-cleanup paths, instead of being failed as 'may have partly applied' and losing the operator's message; a start whose turn was saved is settled from that turn. Selected: the orphan-recovery suite (requeue, saved-turn settlement, attempt bound, published-response cases) and the API-worker regression covering worker cleanup and the fenced claim, in SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, settings or native change. test_runtime_coordination, test_runtime_delivery and test_runtime_auto_recovery were run locally with results identical to clean main and are not selected. The loss was reproduced on a fresh fake Core on main (STUCK) and on this branch (PASS, three runs).
